name: GeForce RTX 5080
description: Documented hardware identity, not a currently purchasable offering or measured runtime tuple. Blackwell precision sources (quoted): the Blackwell precision reference (NVIDIA CUDA programming guide, compute-capabilities Table 33, https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-programming-guide/05-appendices/compute-capabilities.html) states FP6 and FP4 are native Blackwell Tensor Core formats; they map to NO v1 enum slot (FP4 != signed int4, FP6 has no analog) so both are ABSENT from the v1 enum and int4 is correctly absent. Omission here does not imply FP4/FP6 are unsupported.
